ciStatus: Historical PR #244 result only; not the exact current reconciliation candidate and not feature acceptance

audit.status: Historical audit retained; current-main reconciliation candidate requires its own exact-head checks and independent review
audit.note: All in-scope modernization requirements remain partial implementation subsets. No genuine LSP client, cloud provider adapters, executing/durable fleet, self-healing agent or new production deployment is certified by this file.

requirements.name: Win32 Job Object Process Supervision
requirements.state: Partial: packaged Win32 helper prototype; not wired into normal ProcessService execution
requirements.implementedSubset: Helper source and focused lifecycle fixtures are retained. The reconciliation candidate removes automatic helper startup; ordinary Windows cleanup remains the existing best-effort taskkill path.
remaining: Qualify host-owned native containment, process/service lifecycle isolation and Windows installed-package behavior before enabling integration.

requirements.name: Decompose files.ts into Atomic Services
requirements.state: Partial: retry strategy extracted; broad atomic-service decomposition incomplete
requirements.implementedSubset: Retry helpers exist; FileService still owns substantial file, policy and mutation logic.
remaining: Complete the planned atomic-service decomposition with preserved policy, cancellation, conflict and durability semantics.

requirements.name: Shadow Journaling & Pre-Mutation Snapshots
requirements.state: Partial: guarded per-root single-file pre-write snapshots
requirements.implementedSubset: Journal snapshots are scoped to canonical roots and integrate with guarded file writes.
remaining: Complete independent coverage of storage privacy, retention, failure recovery and every intended mutation path.

requirements.name: Transactional mterm_rollback Tool
requirements.state: Partial: conflict-checked single-file rollback; no atomic multi-file transaction
requirements.implementedSubset: Rollback requires one explicit file and its expected post-write version.
remaining: Implement and qualify an all-or-nothing multi-file commit/recovery protocol before claiming transactional rollback.

requirements.name: Semantic Unified Diff Engine (mterm_apply_patch)
requirements.state: Partial: bounded single-file unified-diff application; not AST-aware refactoring
requirements.implementedSubset: Patch target validation and conflict checks are integrated with guarded FileService mutations.
remaining: Complete supported patch edge cases and independent acceptance; cross-file semantic refactoring is not provided.

requirements.name: Pre-Save Syntactic AST Validator
requirements.state: Partial: JS/TS/JSON syntax checks; unsupported parsers fail closed
requirements.implementedSubset: Unavailable languages and conflicting explicit-language overrides cannot return a successful validation result. Syntax checking is not project typechecking.
remaining: Add separately qualified Python, PowerShell, JSX/TSX, JSONC and other parser adapters as needed.

requirements.name: Deterministic Multi-Linter Tool (mterm_lint_check)
requirements.state: Partial: built-in syntax/style diagnostics; no project-linter integration
requirements.implementedSubset: Default linting does not spawn npx, execute project scripts or invoke project-installed linters.
remaining: Integrate intended linters through scoped process admission, cancellation and resource limits.

requirements.name: Automated Code Formatter Tool (mterm_format_file)
requirements.state: Partial: conservative built-in whitespace normalization; no Prettier/Ruff integration
requirements.implementedSubset: The candidate preserves multiline string, escaped-newline and non-code-format regression inputs rather than trimming their meaningful whitespace.
remaining: Implement verified language-aware formatting and controlled external-tool integration before claiming project formatter parity.

requirements.name: 5-Pass Self-Healing Refine Pipeline (RefineEngine)
requirements.state: Partial: one deterministic five-stage refinement pass; no autonomous repair loop
requirements.implementedSubset: The pipeline performs one attempt. Compiler execution is not exposed through MCP pending integration with scoped process controls; no absent compiler result counts as a clean typecheck.
remaining: Implement bounded repair/retry policy, supported parser/formatter/linter stages and safe compiler integration with exact-head evidence.

requirements.name: Language Server Protocol Client (mterm_lsp_*)
requirements.state: Partial lexical navigation only; genuine LSP client not implemented
requirements.implementedSubset: Definition/reference/symbol utilities use a policy-backed bounded source reader with cancellation and strict decoding. Results are heuristic, not compiler-resolved.
remaining: Implement language-server transport, lifecycle, capabilities, document synchronization and compiler-resolved definitions/references.

requirements.name: Dense Repository Map Generator (mterm_repo_map)
requirements.state: Partial: fresh bounded lexical repository outline; no persistent semantic index
requirements.implementedSubset: Source reads use current request policy, file/scan limits and cancellation. The stale HEAD-only disk cache is removed; no cache files are written by read-only mapping.
remaining: Design dirty-tree-safe indexing and persistent cache invalidation without weakening read-only guarantees.

requirements.name: Cloud AI Provider Adapters & Model Router
requirements.state: Partial abstraction and deterministic diff heuristics; cloud AI adapters not implemented
requirements.implementedSubset: No cloud provider is bundled or invoked. An explicitly requested unconfigured provider fails rather than silently substituting the heuristic.
remaining: Implement qualified provider-specific adapters and owner-approved budgets without equating heuristic output to model inference.

requirements.name: 30+ Agent Fleet Supervisor & Fair Queue
requirements.state: Partial: per-FileService in-memory logical task ledger; no executing or durable fleet
requirements.implementedSubset: FIFO admission, logical checkpoints and halt state are in memory. The candidate isolates separate FileService ledgers and rejects task-ID adoption across logical sessions.
remaining: Implement real executors, durable state/recovery, measured fair scheduling, owned worktrees, cancellation and acceptance on actual sessions.

requirements.name: Dual Dev/Prod Isolation (MTermCLI-DEV)
requirements.state: Partial: ordinary CLI config isolation; remote credential/runtime isolation incomplete
requirements.implementedSubset: Development config has a separate directory. The remote state default still ignores development selection, and full backend/App/port separation is not verified.
remaining: Isolate remote profile state and credentials first; separately verify independent staging App/backend/policy and runtime routing.

requirements.name: Enhanced Diagnostics (mterm-cli doctor --json)
requirements.state: Partial: basic doctor JSON inventory; end-to-end readiness not established
requirements.implementedSubset: CLI diagnostics expose basic local configuration/environment observations. They do not prove the canonical plugin, remote executor or production deployment is ready.
remaining: Connect scoped provenance and capability evidence to diagnostics and validate end-to-end readiness separately.
